Class Regions

java.lang.Object
imageproof.Regions
public class Regions extends Object
Splits the image into square tiles (64 x 64 pixels by default) and measures each tile.

Tiles at the right and bottom edges can be smaller when the image size is not a multiple of 64. The variation of a tile is the average TVD between its histogram and the histograms of its neighbours above, below, left and right.

High variation means the tile looks different from its neighbours. Normal object edges do this too, so it is NOT a sign of editing by itself. Noise, Edges and LocalAnomaly use the same tile grid.

    • bounds

      public Rectangle bounds(int row, int col)
      Gives the pixel rectangle covered by one tile. Tiles at the right and bottom edges can be smaller than the tile size.
      Parameters:
      row - tile row, from 0
      col - tile column, from 0
      Returns:
      the rectangle in image pixels
